features.title: Compression reads first
features.what: Logs, chunks and whole files are cut before any model sees the text.
features.evidence_quote: compressed before the agent reads it
features.risk: A cut chunk cannot be read again later in the same session.

features.title: Reading happens before reasoning
features.what: The input is measured and trimmed upstream of the prompt.
features.risk: Measurement costs a pass; the trim is already decided by then.

features.title: Lossy by design
features.what: The cut decides what to drop and does not ask.
features.risk: It decides what to drop and does not ask; a log line you needed is already gone.
